description: Ask the product's support agent a question the way one of the product's users would, to test it (MANAGER+). It answers only from the published help center and the public changelog, never from code, and returns { answer, sources, messageId, conversationId, status, escalation, contactUrl, feedbackAvailable, feedbackDraft }. messageId is the committed assistant message id (including for PAUSED), not a read or continuation credential. status is ANSWERED, ESCALATED (it suggested contacting the team) or PAUSED (the support budget is used up, and answer points to matching pages). escalation is QUESTION, PROBLEM or IDEA once the conversation escalated, else null. feedbackAvailable is always false and feedbackDraft always null here: rating an answer and sending a message to the team are for the product's users, not a test. Pass conversationId back to continue. Spends the support share of the organization's credits, like an answer through the Support API. Needs a live help center.

conversationId.description: The conversationId from the previous answer, to continue that conversation. Omit it to start a new one.

locale.description: Help language to search. Omit it for the help center's default. A missing translation uses a published page in the default language.
